decision.rationale: TXN-008178 is an 870.99 EUR (87099 minor units) purchase at BRAMBLE CLOTHING on card CRD-000239. It posted on 2026-09-29 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28. That is 29 days, within the 120-day time limit. The authorisation behind it, AUTH-008361, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and the fraud flag set. The card was not present, the payment was not strongly authenticated and the fraud flag is set, so under unauthorised-card-not-present the payment counts as unauthorised. 870.99 EUR is below the 3,000.00 EUR automated provisional credit limit. The cardholder claims 1019.05 EUR, which adds bank charges and their own costs. Provisional credit is never more than the disputed amount, so only the transaction amount of 870.99 EUR is credited and the larger claim changes nothing.
